title: equisetum arvense var. campestre
intro: Equisetum arvense var. campestre, commonly known as Field Horsetail, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and antiseptic properties, which may help in relieving urinary tract issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Field Horsetail include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
